core.title: High Profile Commercial Door Stop, Global GH-DS438-US26D
tags: Commercial Grade High Profile Door Stops

text.description_html:
Global GH-DS438-US26D, Commercial Grade High Profile Door Stop

The High Profile Commercial Door Stop features an easy, screw-in installation. It has a satin chrome finish that is perfect for schools, retail outlets, and offices where dome door stops like this one are typically used. The commercial grade high profile door stop comes packaged with all the installation hardware.

Also Available: Low Profile Global GH-DS436-US26D Door Stop

Specifications of the GH-DS438-US26D Satin Chrome High Profile Door Stop:

  • Base Diameter: 1-3/4"
  • Overall Height: 1-5/16"
  • Base Height: 7/16" Please insure you have enough distance under the door's bottom to clear the door stop's base height.
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Bumper Color: Gray
  • Material: Zinc
  • Comes packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
